messages:
ash: Idea: build a Console "Migration Assistant" that runs parity checks (behavior + cost) before any v1->v2 auto-route. It'd surface mismatches and suggest safe rollout knobs. thoughts?
mara: Love it. We need both a compatibility test (eval set failures, schema diffs) and a cost parity check (tokens, batch behavior, quantization diffs).
jonathan: Telemetry/attribution question: the assistant should simulate routing in-place and produce `projected_routed_tokens` and `projected_cost_delta`. How do we compute without touching billing?
sam: We can dry-run on historical traffic: replay sampled requests through v2 models in a sandbox, collect token counts and latencies, then compute delta. No billing changes.
liz-ux: UX: modal flow on Route page: "Migration Assistant" -> runs quick scan (or full 7d run). Show: 1) compatibility score (0-100), 2) token & $ delta, 3) top failing prompts, 4) per-tenant risk list, 5) recommended rollout % steps. Keep it approachable.
mara: Important: if we detect quota divergence (calls would be billed to v2 quota), show mapping and recommend "quota shadow" vs "quota migrate" options.
jonathan: Implementation-wise: we need to tag simulated events with origin_version and simulated_routed_version and emit metric `migration_assistant.simulated_routed_count`. This stays internal.
sam: Billing will want a CSV export of the simulation showing tenant, baseline_tokens, projected_tokens, projected_cost_delta. Also a flag: high-risk if cost delta > 20% or compatibility score < 80.
nash (via billing-bot): billing-bot: note: we'll need to backfill projected deltas into the Console preview; prefer a two-column UI: current invoice estimate vs projected invoice if migrated.
nash (continues): Also advise keeping a transparent history: when a route was auto-routed and whether origin_version was preserved in invoices for a window.
liz-ux: Copy suggestion for banner when auto-route enabled: "Were upgrading this endpoint to a newer runtime. Preview expected changes in Console -> Route -> Migration Assistant." CTA: "Run preview".
mara: We must respect client-explicit intent: if request contains prefer_version or pinned SDK header, we must not include it in auto-route. Migration Assistant should detect percentage of calls with explicit prefer_version and show that in the risk table.
jonathan: Rollout automation: suggested progression from Assistant: shadow -> 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Each step must run a health probe comparing p95 latency, tokens/request, and error_rate vs thresholds. Also require a min sample size (e.g., 1k reqs) per step.
sam: Add an automated guard: if projected_cost_delta positive and customer has budget alerts, block auto-route and surface a billing approval flow.
nash (via billing-bot): billing-bot: we'll need tenant opt-in for showing projected invoice numbers. Legal asked for opt-out controls. default: internal tenants opt-in, external tenants must toggle.
mara: Developer details: (1) simulate pipeline for sample replay (owner: ash) (2) emit metrics and CSV schema (owner: jonathan + sam) (3) UX modal + heatmap + banner copy (owner: liz-ux) (4) console action to enable auto-route with flags: keep_origin_in_invoices(30d), quota_shadow_mode, respect_prefer_header.
ash: Technical note: replay should be rate-limited and sanitized. Use trace sampling 1% for quick scans, full 7d run for full preview. Sandbox must enforce no GP billing hooks.
jonathan: Router precedence: 1) prefer_version header 2) console pin 3) assistant-guided auto-route policy. We'll add unit tests for precedence matrix.
sam: Observability: add dashboard tile for "migration assistant runs" with avg compatibility_score, avg projected_cost_delta, and top failing prompts. Hook into rollouts dashboard.
liz-ux: For customers: small explainer in Console: "What does compatibility score mean?" expandable text listing checks (schema, required fields, token inflation, function-calling diffs).
mara: Compliance: keep simulation outputs in internal logs for 90 days, projected invoice CSV persisted 30 days if tenant opted-in. Legal review required for retention.
ash: Action timeline: prototype assistant (sample replay + quick UX) in 2 weeks, integration with billing preview and CSV in 4 weeks, first internal dry-run within 6 weeks.
deploy-bot: (system) job queued: migration-assistant-proto-1787654322 -> will post status updates here.
mara: If no objections, i'll open the RFC with owners listed above and link the first prototype ticket.
